orderingRule: A wave cannot start until predecessor proof and human gate pass. Before any current ACL is revoked, the actual application caller inventory must prove that every removed direct read and write has a compatible trusted replacement already qualified. Any dependent caller stops the wave. Rollback never restores broad browser privileges.

waves.name: Legacy ACL and default-privilege closure
waves.goal: remove unintended object reachability only after compatible trusted replacements are operationally proved
preconditions: complete actual application caller inventory for every read and write proposed for removal
one shared trusted profile presentation context qualified against every current consumer and using an exact server-only database gateway rather than the authenticated user client
trusted inventory-history route qualified with the exact response allowlist, tenant/branch predicates, page limit and date-window bounds
all other removed reads/writes mapped to compatible trusted replacements
application compatibility demonstrated before privilege closure
stopConditions: any caller still depends on removed profile table/view access
profile route still queries through the user-bound authenticated database role
any caller still depends on authenticated inventory_movements or inventory_movements_view access
any removed direct write/read lacks a tested trusted replacement
response shape or authorized scope differs without an approved compatibility migration
waves.compatibility: trusted server routes must already cover every removed direct read and write; getCurrentUserProfile and inventory history must consume their trusted replacements before revocation
waves.applicationDependency: no route or page may rely on direct legacy browser mutation/read being removed
waves.lockRisk: short catalog locks; enumerate exact objects
validation: profiles direct Data API denied, server-only route database caller, and exact server projection fields
inventory base/view direct Data API denied and server route compatibility
waves.rollback: disable the affected route/feature or revert application traffic to an already qualified trusted replacement; never restore broad privileges, profile browser grants, inventory view/base browser grants, broad writes or PUBLIC execute

waves.name: RLS replacement
waves.goal: remove permissive OR bypass, close profile/inventory browser policies, and install one scoped model per genuinely retained direct read
waves.compatibility: catalog/branch/VAT direct reads keep response shape; profile and inventory movement reads use trusted server routes; other removed tables use routes/RPC
waves.applicationDependency: profile presentation, inventory history, customer/history/status callers verified
waves.lockRisk: policy catalog locks only; schedule bounded window
validation: profiles no browser policy and no forbidden columns
inventory base/view no browser policy or object access
waves.rollback: disable affected direct reads and use already qualified trusted routes; do not restore broad policies or browser profile/inventory privileges
waves.humanApproval: security, DBA and POS product owner

waves.name: Definer retirement and hardening
waves.goal: eliminate broad owner-function paths and unsafe name resolution
waves.compatibility: bounded online compatibility for server routes; no Offline use
waves.applicationDependency: Core order route and server admin/customer routes
waves.lockRisk: function replacement invalidation; deploy signatures compatibly
waves.rollback: switch server routes to prior safe Online version while keeping broad execute closed

waves.name: Device and employee authority
waves.goal: install one-device and event-governed employee/package authority
waves.compatibility: new objects unused; online POS actor remains unchanged
waves.rollback: disable enrollment/acquisition, revoke test devices, preserve audit

waves.name: Persistent unwrap metadata
waves.goal: install package/envelope metadata without enabling client unwrap
waves.rollback: stop issuance; retain revocation/audit and purge test packages

waves.name: Core actual actor and device bridge
waves.goal: atomically bind Primary Auth, POS employee, device and generations
waves.compatibility: online path continues through existing context; offline signature disabled
waves.lockRisk: same command/claim lock order; avoid new branch locks in execute
waves.dataRewrite: optional explicit null/not-applicable values for historical online rows, never inferred actor
waves.rollback: disable offline acquisition and retain online Core path; preserve companion evidence

waves.name: Review, payment, inventory and effect authority
waves.goal: complete business-conflict, all-payment, snapshot/frontier and effect-intent prerequisites
waves.compatibility: new receipt fields are versioned/optional for old clients
waves.lockRisk: inventory item locks, cancellation locks, effect claim contention
waves.dataRewrite: no rewrite of historical commands; explicit unknown states
waves.rollback: stop new feature paths/workers; retain immutable evidence and existing receipts
waves.killSwitch: per-domain plus global offline dispatch off

waves.name: Catalog attestation and hostile qualification
waves.goal: prove effective authority and runtime behavior before clients
waves.lockRisk: read-only inspection plus isolated load tests
waves.rollback: block next wave and correct under new review

waves.name: Disabled client integration
waves.goal: wire device/package/sync UI and transport without business enablement
waves.lockRisk: none in database hot path while disabled
waves.rollback: remove/disable integration while preserving server authority evidence

waves.name: Pilot readiness
waves.goal: qualify one branch/device and order.create only without Production enablement in this phase
preconditions: fresh Production read-only attestation after separately authorized deployment
waves.rollback: disable pilot/acquisition/dispatcher; preserve queued evidence for governed review
waves.killSwitch: global, tenant, branch, device and command-type

forbidden: No wave contains executable syntax, implementation authorization, Production access, or permission to start Phase 5.
